If a product doesn’t work out, you have several options depending on the item and its condition:

Mattresses

100-night in-home sleep trial starting from delivery.
If unused/in box (within ~30 days): free prepaid return label, 100% refund once tracking shows it’s on the way back.
If opened/used (after required adjustment period within 100 days): you can return at no cost as long as it’s in sanitary, donatable condition; we’ll arrange a free donation pickup.

Toppers

30-day trial.
Unopened or like-new, restorable to original packaging (within 30 days): free prepaid label, 100% refund.
Opened and used (within 30 days): you can still return if it’s clean and in donatable condition.

Pillows, bedding, bed frames

Unopened: 30 days, free return label, 100% refund.
Opened: covered by warranty only, not eligible for change‑of‑mind returns.

Orders you want to cancel before using the product

If not shipped yet: we can cancel.
If shipped but intercepted, or delivered and you get it returned unopened and intact: cancellation can still be processed.
If cancellation fails, you may:
Try the item and keep it, or
Return the package for a refund, or
Refuse delivery so it’s sent back and then refunded when received intact.

Refund handling

Refunds are issued to the original payment method; timing depends on your bank/financing provider.
If your bank info changed, your bank will help route the funds or issue a check; you may need to contact your bank directly.

Throughout, our in‑home trial and return setup are designed to reduce purchase risk and support hassle‑free resolution if you’re not satisfied.
